NEW_REQUEST.description: A standalone request for a new deliverable, artifact, answer, draft, workflow, translation, or summary.
examples: Write a lower third about AI regulation.
Draft outreach email to a guest.

TRANSFORM_EXISTING.description: A request to modify the active previous artifact or output while preserving its artifact/work product identity.
negative_guidance: Do not use for delivery, sending, approval, saving, scheduling, or other workflow actions on the active artifact.
Do not use just because the user refers to existing work; the requested operation must be an edit/revision.

CONVERT_ARTIFACT.description: A request to turn the active artifact or content into a different artifact type.
examples: Turn this into a lower third.
Convert this to a producer note.
Turn the guest list into outreach.

CONTINUE_WORKFLOW.description: A request to continue a workflow without transforming the artifact content.
examples: Draft outreach to the second guest.

ANSWER_QUESTION.description: A normal question or explanation request.
